lines.text: The song is for the choirmaster, with stringed instruments, and asks God to be gracious and bless us.
The song asks that God's ways be known on earth and His salvation among all nations.
The chorus calls on the kings of Judah to praise God, and says the nations can sing for joy.
The earth has yielded its silver, and God, our God, blesses us.
God blesses us, so that all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.
